bridge.criterion: at least one fundamental motif and at least one individual motif

definitions.fundamental_hypothesis: Consciousness, at the fundamental scale, is the putative primordial or encompassing dimension within which differentiated subject, object, world, and experience arise.
definitions.individual_definition: Individual consciousness is a temporally unfolding, interiorly present and unified-yet-differentiated point of view in which a world is encountered, the process can be related to its own changing condition, and differences can acquire significance.
definitions.bridge_hypothesis: Individual consciousness may be a localized, differentiated, embodied, or otherwise constrained mode of a more fundamental consciousness.

epistemic_status.fundamental: cross-source metaphysical hypothesis; recurring but not established fact
epistemic_status.bridge: synthetic hypothesis derived from bridge-claim pattern

next_gate: adversarial claim-level review across all 4,315 records, prioritizing bridge claims and counterclaims
